story : I want to validate login

user +types+ the ~username~ as *connected2atul@gmail.com*
user +types+ the ~password~ as *qwerty123*

story : Login with natural language format
    Click the sign in button on the home page
    Type connected2atul@gmail.com into the username field
    Type qwerty123 into the password field
    Click the login button with xpath://input[@value='Sign In']
    Verify the Schedule Build page appears

story : Logout with natural language format
    Click the logout button with xpath://li[9]/a/p
    Verify the home page appears

story : Validate text with natural language format
    Type connected2atul@gmail.com into the username field with id:username
    Type qwerty123 into the password field with id:password
    Click the login button with xpath://input[@value='Sign In']
    Click the Schedule Build link
    Verify the Welcome message appears with xpath://h1

compose : Login stories
    Login with natural language format
    Logout with natural language format
    Validate text with natural language format

test : Run all login stories

scenario : start zoomcar booking
+click+ on the search tab on the home Page using ~linkText:Start your wonderful journey~

scenario : perform search
+click+ on the search bar  defined by ~xpath://input[@type='text']~ 
+clear+ the search bar defined by ~xpath://input[@type='text']~ 
+type+ the partial starting point as *indra* in the search bar defined by ~xpath://input[@type='text']~ 
+click+ on the suggested location as Indranagar defined by ~xpath://body~ 
+click+ on the next button defined by ~xpath://button~ to go to date page

scenario: select date and time
+click+ on the element defined by ~xpath://div[3]/div[2]/div[3]~ to select starting date
+click+ on the slider time defined by ~xpath://li[43]~ to choose time
+click+ on the next button defined by ~xpath://button~ to go to choose end time page
+click+ on the element defined by ~xpath://div[3]/div[2]/div[3]~ to select end date
+click+ on the slider time defined by ~xpath://li[19]~  to choose time
+click+ on the next button defined by ~xpath://button~ to go to select car page
user then +waits+ for *8* seconds

scenario : select car and login
+click+ on the element defined by ~link:book-now~
//it will open login modal where you need to pass login details
+click+ on the user email field defined by ~xpath://input[@type='text']~
+type+ the user email *atul.sharma@zoomcar.com* in the locator identified by ~xpath://input[@type='text']~
+click+ on the next button defined by ~cssSelector:img.zc-auth-next-icon~
+type+ password *aabc581321* in the element identified by the locator ~xpath://input[@type='password']~

scenario: checkout the selected car
+click+ on the element identified by the locator ~xpath://form/div[3]/img~
+click+ on the element identified by the locator ~id:checkoutButton~ to checkout the car

scenario:initiate payment
+click+ on the element defined by identifier ~id:card~
+click+ on the element defined by identifier ~id:expiry-month~
+type+ on the element defined by identifier ~id:expiry-month~ and enter month as *08*
+click+ on the element defined by identifier ~id:expiry-year~
+type+ on the element defined by identifier ~id:expiry-year~ and enter year as *2019*
+click+ on the element defined by identifier ~id:cvv~
+type+  the cvv as  *123* in the text box defined by identifier ~id:cvv~
+click+ on the element defined by identifier ~xpath://input[@type='text']~
+type+ in text box identifier ~xpath://input[@type='text']~ and enter card number *5123  4567  8901  2346*

scenario: logout
+click+ on the menu icon identified by the locator ~id:user_name_header~ to open user menu
+click+ on the logout button identified by the locator ~linkText:LOGOUT~ to log out of the application
